en:
Changing Unit Classes

You can change your unit class at any Command Post controlled by your team.  Approach a CP followed by pressing [E] to change units.
zh:
更换兵种

你可以在我方控制的任何指挥点更换兵种。靠近指挥点后按[E]即可更换单位。

en: Press [E] while close a vehicle to enter it. Press [E] again to exit.
zh: 靠近载具时按[E]进入。再次按[E]退出。

en: [1] will switch to the fusion cutter while using the engineer class. [Mouse Button 1] while next to a vehicle will repair a friendly vehicle or attempt to slice into an enemy vehicle.
zh: 使用工程兵时，[1]可切换为聚变切割器。在载具旁按住[鼠标左键]可修复友方载具，或尝试破解敌方载具。

en:
Head Shots

A well aimed shot from a sniper unit can prove to be quite deadly. [Z] will allow you to zoom in and accurately target your enemy's head.
zh:
爆头

狙击兵精准的一枪可以造成致命伤害。[Z]可放大瞄准，精确锁定敌人的头部。

en:
Rocket Lock-On

Press [Q] to lock onto a vehicle with the rocket launcher.  When the vehicle lockon indicator turns red, you are locked on, and your rockets will track to their target.
zh:
火箭锁定

按[Q]使用火箭筒锁定载具。当载具锁定指示器变红时即锁定成功，火箭将追踪目标。

en: During this training mission, you can access hints from the objective/map screens with the 'Lock Target' key.  Viewing these hints is strongly recommended as they will teach you various aspects of playing Battlefront II.
zh: 在本训练任务中，你可以按"锁定目标"键在任务/地图界面查看提示。强烈建议查看这些提示，它们将教你《前线II》的各种玩法。

en:
Force Powers

Press [MOUSE BUTTON 2] to use a Jedi's force powers. Force Powers vary from Jedi to Jedi.
zh:
原力技能

按[鼠标右键]使用绝地的原力技能。每位绝地的原力技能各不相同。

en:
Force Jump

[SPACE] twice as a Jedi will allow you to jump much higher and further.
zh:
原力跳跃

绝地连按两次[空格]，即可跳得更高更远。

en:
Try using the Jet Trooper's flight ability to reach the cliff command post quickly.

[SPACE] twice will activate your jetpack. Press it again to deactivate the jetpack.
zh:
尝试利用喷气兵的飞行能力，快速抵达悬崖指挥点。

连按两次[空格]启动喷气背包，再次按下将其关闭。

en:
Target Lock

Press [Q] to lock on to enemy targets, and again to select another target. Hold down [Q] to clear your target.
zh:
目标锁定

按[Q]锁定敌人目标，再次按[Q]选择下一个目标。按住[Q]清除当前目标。

en:
Basic Movement Controls

[W], [S], [A] and [D] will allow you to move your unit forward, backward and side to side. The mouse will allow you to look up/down and turn.
zh:
基础移动操作

[W]、[S]、[A]和[D]可控制单位前进、后退及左右移动。鼠标用于上下观察和转向。

en:
You'll need to use the jet trooper's flight ability to reach the holocron.

[SPACE] twice will activate your jetpack. [SPACE] again will deactivate it.
zh:
你需要利用喷气兵的飞行能力抵达全息记录仪。

连按两次[空格]启动喷气背包，再次按[空格]将其关闭。

en:
For this objective, you'll need to use the Heavy Weapons class.

Remember, you can change units at any command post under your team's control by approaching it, followed by [E].
zh:
完成此目标需要使用重武器兵种。

记住，靠近我方控制的任何指挥点并按[E]即可更换兵种。

en: Activate your mini-map with [M] when hunting down any remaining enemies.
zh: 追剿残余敌人时，按[M]打开小地图。

en: [M] will allow you to review your objectives.  Completed objectives are displayed in gray, and active objectives are displayed in gold.
zh: 按[M]可查看你的任务。已完成的任务以灰色显示，进行中的任务以金色显示。

en:
Sprinting

Moving forward followed by tapping or holding [SHIFT] will allow you to sprint and get around the battlefield more quickly. To turn sprint off, release or tap [SHIFT].
zh:
冲刺

向前移动时轻按或按住[SHIFT]即可冲刺，更快地在战场中移动。松开或轻按[SHIFT]关闭冲刺。

en:
Vehicle Weapon Positions

Press [1] or [2] to change weapon positions in the AT-TE.
zh:
载具武器位

在AT-TE中按[1]或[2]切换武器位。

en:
[MOUSE BUTTON 1] and [MOUSE BUTTON 2] fire primary and secondary weapons. 

[1] and [2] will switch your primary and secondary weapons.
zh:
[鼠标左键]和[鼠标右键]发射主武器和副武器。

[1]和[2]切换主武器和副武器。

en:
Zoom

[Z] will allow you to zoom in with any weapon.
zh:
缩放

按[Z]可使用任何武器放大瞄准。

en: Acquire the Sith Holocron.  You'll need to use the Jet Trooper's flight ability.  [SPACE] twice to fly.  [SPACE] again to cancel flight.
zh: 获取西斯全息记录仪。你需要使用喷气兵的飞行能力。连按两次[空格]起飞，再次按[空格]取消飞行。

en: Change your unit class to the Jet Trooper at a Command Post.  Remember, [E] changes units after approaching a CP controlled by your team.
zh: 在指挥点将你的兵种更换为喷气兵。记住，靠近我方控制的指挥点后按[E]即可更换兵种。

en: Go to the AT-TE and get inside. To enter a vehicle, approach the vehicle followed by [E].
zh: 前往AT-TE并进入其中。进入载具时，靠近载具后按[E]。

en:
Droid scouts have been detected in the area.  Destroy them with your primary weapons. [MOUSE BUTTON 1]  to fire and [1] to switch primary weapons.

All controls shown are based on the control presets.
zh:
已在该区域发现侦察机器人。用你的主武器消灭它们。[鼠标左键]开火，[1]切换主武器。

所有显示的操作均基于默认控制预设。

en:
Destroy the damaged Hailfire droid with your Thermal Detonators.  
[MOUSE BUTTON 2] to throw your thermal detonators.
zh:
使用热能手雷摧毁受损的冰雹机器人。
[鼠标右键]投掷热能手雷。

en: Repair the Health and Ammo Recharge Droids.  [1] to switch to the fusion cutter then hold [MOUSE BUTTON 1] to repair the droids.
zh: 修复生命值与弹药补给机器人。[1]切换到聚变切割器，然后按住[鼠标左键]修复机器人。

en: Change to the Engineer class at the downed Techno Union ship CP.  To change units, approach a CP controlled by your team followed by [E].
zh: 在坠毁的技术联盟飞船指挥点处更换为工程兵兵种。更换兵种时，靠近我方控制的指挥点后按[E]。

en:
Press [E] near a fighter to enter it. Tap [SPACE] to launch into space.

You can see more hints by pressing the 'Lock Target' key on the map screen.  All displayed controls are based on the presets. You can change starfighter controls by pausing the game and choosing Options. Select Controls and choose Starfighter Controls.
zh:
在战斗机旁按[E]进入。轻按[空格]起飞进入太空。

在地图界面按"锁定目标"键可查看更多提示。所有显示的操作均基于预设。你可以在暂停游戏后选择"选项"，进入"控制"并选择"战斗机控制"来更改战斗机操作。

en:
Destroy 5 incoming CIS fighters.

The easiest way to shoot down enemy fighters is to fire homing missiles at them. Press [Q] to lock onto an enemy fighter. Line it up with your reticule, wait until the small circle turns red, then press [MOUSE BUTTON 2] to fire homing missiles at the enemy.
zh:
摧毁5架来袭的分离势力战斗机。

击落敌机最简便的方法是向其发射追踪导弹。按[Q]锁定敌机。将准星对准敌机，等待小圆圈变红后，按[鼠标右键]发射追踪导弹。

en:
Attack and destroy the enemy frigate with your lasers and torpedoes.

Use evasive maneuvers to avoid defensive fire from enemies. Press [ALT] once followed by a 'Turn/Pitch' direction to perform a maneuver. Press [ALT] twice or [C] followed by a 'Turn/Pitch' direction for advanced maneuvers.
zh:
用激光与鱼雷攻击并摧毁敌方护卫舰。

使用规避机动躲避敌人的防御火力。按一次[ALT]后接"转向/俯仰"方向键执行机动。连按两次[ALT]，或按[C]后接"转向/俯仰"方向键执行高级机动。

en:
Attack and destroy the Communications Relay on top of the Trade Federation Cruiser.

Destroying a capital ship's critical systems will cripple it. You can lock onto a critical system by tapping [Q] when your fighter is pointed at it.
zh:
攻击并摧毁贸易联邦巡洋舰顶部的通讯中继站。

摧毁主力舰的关键系统可使其瘫痪。当战斗机对准关键系统时，轻按[Q]即可锁定。

en:
Make your way into the CIS hangar and land your ship.

Ease off the throttle by pressing [S] when entering a hangar. Tap [SPACE] once to land your fighter inside the hangar.
zh:
进入分离势力机库并降落你的飞船。

进入机库时按[S]减小推进器。轻按一次[空格]在机库内降落战斗机。

en:
Enter a Flyer

Approach an Arc-170, followed by [E] to enter it.

All controls shown are based on the control presets.
zh:
进入飞行器

靠近ARC-170后按[E]进入。

所有显示的操作均基于默认控制预设。

en:
Taking Off

[SPACE] to take-off and land while in a ship.
zh:
起飞

驾驶飞船时按[空格]起飞和降落。

en:
ARC-170

The ARC-170 is a multi-purpose fighter. [MOUSE BUTTON 1] fires rapid pulse lasers, while [MOUSE BUTTON 2] will fire proton torpedoes.
zh:
ARC-170

ARC-170是一种多用途战斗机。[鼠标左键]发射快速脉冲激光，[鼠标右键]发射质子鱼雷。

en:
Evasive Maneuvers

Tap [ALT] followed by a 'Turn/Pitch' direction to use evasive maneuvers. Try [ALT] twice or [CAPS LOCK] followed by 'Turn/Pitch' direction for more advanced maneuvers.
zh:
规避机动

轻按[ALT]后接"转向/俯仰"方向键使用规避机动。连按两次[ALT]，或按[大写锁定]后接"转向/俯仰"方向键，可执行更高级的机动。

en:
Targeting

Press [Q] to lock onto and switch targets. For locking weapons, wait for the tracking reticule to turn red and then press [MOUSE BUTTON 1] to fire.
zh:
目标锁定

按[Q]锁定并切换目标。使用锁定武器时，等待追踪准星变红，然后按[鼠标左键]开火。

en:
Landing

Press [SPACE] to land once you have entered a safe landing zone within a capital ship.
zh:
降落

进入主力舰内的安全降落区后，按[空格]降落。

en:
Assault
Destroy enemy critical systems (18 points), frigates (18 points), and fighters (3 points). (Mos Eisley: Destroy all enemy units).
zh:
突击
摧毁敌方关键系统（18分）、护卫舰（18分）和战斗机（3分）。（莫斯艾斯利：摧毁所有敌方单位）。

zh: 在一命内用火箭筒对载具造成 %s 次致命命中，即可获得遥控火箭发射器。

zh: 在一命内获得 %s 分，即可解锁能量恢复加成。

zh: 在一命内用爆能步枪击杀 %s 名敌人，即可解锁精英步枪。

zh: 在一命内用手枪击杀 %s 名敌人，即可获得精准手枪。

zh: 在一命内用狙击枪爆头 %s 次，即可解锁光束步枪。

Order 66 has been given. The Jedi collaborators must be eliminated. On Coruscant, the 501st has been given the singular honor of executing this order under the command of the newly annointed Lord Vader.
zh: 第66号命令已下达。绝地叛徒必须被清除。在科洛桑，501军团荣幸地肩负起执行此命令的重任，由新受封的维达勋爵指挥。

en: A contingent of Rebel prisoners have escaped from their cells. Making matters worse is the fact they have also managed to steal the technical readouts to the Death Star. Eliminate the prisoners and secure the plans before they are beamed off-station.
zh: 一批义军囚犯越狱逃脱。更糟的是，他们还盗走了死星的技术图纸。趁图纸尚未被传送离站，消灭囚犯并夺回图纸。

en: The CIS is entrenched on Felucia, and have beaten back several attacks. The 182nd Legion landed last month and hasn't been heard from since. As the Republic's finest, the burden is now upon the 501st to liberate Felucia.
zh: 分离势力在费卢西亚盘踞已久，击退了数次进攻。第182军团上月登陆后便音信全无。作为共和国的精锐，解放费卢西亚的重任落在了501军团肩上。

en: The Grand Army of the Republic is making its debut on the plains of Geonosis. Leading the way are the troopers of the 501st Legion. Learn the basics of units, weapons, and mission objectives while trying to survive the 501st's first foray into combat.
zh: 共和国大军即将在吉奥诺西斯平原首度登场，领队的是501军团的士兵。在经历501军团的首场战斗之余，学习单位、武器与任务目标的基础知识。

en: Lord Vader has discovered the hidden Rebel base on Hoth. General Veers is leading the ground assault on the base's shield generators. Lord Vader will land once the generators are down and personally see to the destruction of the Rebel base and the end of the Rebellion.
zh: 维达勋爵发现了义军在霍斯的秘密基地。维尔斯将军正率地面部队进攻基地的护盾发生器。一旦发生器被摧毁，维达勋爵将亲自登陆，确保义军基地被摧毁、义军同盟彻底覆灭。

en: The Kaminoans have turned against the Empire and are using our own brothers against us. Lord Vader has hired a special mercenary to lead us in this difficult battle. He has unique knowledge of the cloning chambers that will be invaluable during the siege.
zh: 卡米诺人背叛了帝国，利用我们的同胞兄弟来对付我们。维达勋爵雇用了一名特殊雇佣兵来带领我们进行这场艰难的战斗。他对克隆室的独特了解将在围城战中发挥不可估量的作用。

en: The 501st has reinforced the Wookiee defenders at a key refinery. Master Yoda himself is coordinating the defense of this critical installation. The line has been drawn, there can be no retreat.
zh: 501军团增援了关键精炼厂的伍基守军。尤达大师亲自指挥这一关键设施的防御。战线已划定，绝无退路。

en: Gizor Delso has built prototypes of a new battle droid in the hopes of resurrecting the CIS army. Destroy the plans for this prototype and any reactivated battle droids in the mining facility. Needless to say, Delso must be found and terminated.
zh: 吉佐·德尔索建造了新战斗机器人的原型，妄图复活分离势力军队。摧毁这座采矿设施中该原型机的图纸以及所有被重新激活的战斗机器人。不用说，德尔索必须被找到并消灭。

en: General Ki-Adi-Mundi is leading the attack on the CIS manufacturing planet of Mygeeto. A powerful Energy Collector supplies power to its factories. Destroy the Energy Collector and recover the unique power crystals from its core.
zh: 基-阿迪-芒迪将军正率军进攻分离势力的制造星球麦基托。一座强大的能量收集器为那里的工厂供电。摧毁能量收集器，并从其核心取回独特的能量水晶。

en: The Empire is flourishing under Emperor Palpatine but there are still elements that resist the New Order. Chief among these is the Queen of Naboo; rumor has it she is also sheltering fugitive Jedi. It is time to bring Vader's Fist down on these traitors.
zh: 帝国在帕尔帕廷皇帝的统治下日益强盛，但仍有人反抗新秩序。为首者便是纳布女王；传闻她还窝藏逃亡的绝地武士。是时候让维达之拳砸向这些叛徒了。

en: The Death Star plans have not been secured as previously thought. Imperial Intelligence has tracked the plans to a small Rebel outpost in the Polis Massa system. Recover the plans and destroy the Rebel outpost.
zh: 死星图纸并未如先前所想的那样被夺回。帝国情报部追踪图纸至波利斯·马萨星系中一座小型义军前哨站。夺回图纸并摧毁该义军前哨站。

en: The Rebel scum are fleeing their base on Yavin 4. Imperial Intelligence believes most of their command staff is spread among the transport ships. Destroy the transports before they can make the jump to hyperspace, then attack the remaining warships.
zh: 义军渣滓正在逃离他们在雅文4号的基地。帝国情报部相信他们大部分指挥人员分散在各运输船中。趁它们跃入超空间之前摧毁运输船，然后攻击剩余的战舰。

en: General Grievous is holding the Supreme Chancellor hostage aboard his flagship. The Jedi are on their way but the 501st must first clear a path through the Separatist fleet. Engage the nearest CIS cruiser and destroy it.
zh: 格里弗斯将军在其旗舰上挟持了最高议长。绝地正在赶来，但501军团必须率先为分离势力舰队杀出一条血路。接敌最近的分离势力巡洋舰并将其摧毁。

en: The CIS is laying siege to the Wookiee homeworld of Kashyyyk. Break through the enemy blockade and relieve the beleaguered garrison until more reinforcements arrive. Destroy the Separatist flagship at all costs.
zh: 分离势力正围攻伍基人的母星卡希克。突破敌方封锁，在增援抵达前解围受困的驻军。不惜一切代价摧毁分离势力旗舰。

en: Gizor Delso, a Geonosian fugitive from the Clone Wars, has reactivated a battle droid army in the Mustafar system. The 501st is in the system but its Star Destroyer has been boarded by Delso's forces. Repel the enemy boarders and take the fight to them.
zh: 吉佐·德尔索，一名克隆战争时期的吉奥诺西斯逃犯，在穆斯塔法星系重新激活了一支战斗机器人军队。501军团已抵达该星系，但其歼星舰已被德尔索的部队登舰。击退敌方登舰者，将战火烧向他们。

en: The Kaminoans have stabbed our backs for the last time.  They dare to rebel against our might and will pay with their lives.  The cowards are trying to escape our grasp and spread their filth across this galaxy.  They will not succeed in their mission; they will not undermine the power of the Empire.
zh: 卡米诺人最后一次背叛了我们。他们竟敢反抗我们的威势，必将付出生命的代价。这些懦夫企图逃出我们的手心，把他们的污秽散布到整个银河。他们不会得逞；他们动摇不了帝国的力量。

en: Lord Vader has determined the Death Star plans were beamed to the Tantive IV, a consular ship under the flag of Alderaan. The Ambassador, Princess Leia Organa, is believed to be a member of the Rebel Alliance. The 501st will storm the ship, recover the plans, and take Leia Organa prisoner.
zh: 维达勋爵断定死星图纸已被传送到坦蒂夫四号——一艘悬挂奥德朗旗帜的领事船。大使莱娅·奥加纳公主被认为与义军同盟有关联。501军团将强攻该船，夺回图纸，并逮捕莱娅·奥加纳。

en: Republic Intelligence believes General Grievous is here on Utapau. General Kenobi has gone ahead by himself to scout the planet. Secure a landing area and link up with Kenobi to crush the Separatists once and for all.
zh: 共和国情报部认为格里弗斯将军就在尤塔帕。克诺比将军已独自先行侦察这颗星球。确保登陆区域安全，与克诺比会合，一举粉碎分离势力。

en: The Rebels still maintain a sizable force in their base on Yavin. The 501st has been given the honor of avenging the Death Star's destruction. Remember your brethren aboard the battle station and show the traitors no mercy.
zh: 义军仍在其雅文基地保有一支可观的力量。501军团肩负起为死星复仇的重任。记住战斗空间站上的同胞，对叛徒绝不留情。

en: A powerful energy source must be acquired from the CIS manufacturing plant.
zh: 必须从分离势力制造工厂获取强大的能量源。

en: The Geonosian insurrectionist must be destroyed, along with his droids and facilities.
zh: 吉奥诺西斯叛乱分子必须被消灭，连同他的机器人和设施。

en: The Kaminoan facility must be seized. They resist us with our own brethren.
zh: 必须夺取卡米诺设施。他们用我们的同胞兄弟来抵抗我们。

en: Military detainees aboard our secret battle station have broken free. They must not escape.
zh: 我们秘密战斗空间站上的军事拘留犯已越狱。他们绝不能逃脱。

en: The Death Star plans have been traced to a secret Rebel facility hidden in an asteroid field.
zh: 死星图纸已被追踪到隐藏在陨石带中的秘密义军设施。

en: Lord Vader has sensed the plans are aboard a consular ship making its way to Tatooine.
zh: 维达勋爵感应到图纸在一艘正前往塔图因的领事船上。

en: The Rebels must not escape our retribution. Strike them out of the skies.
zh: 义军绝不能逃脱我们的惩罚。将他们从天空中击落。

en: Their base is ripe for the taking. The Death Star's destruction will be repaid in blood.
zh: 他们的基地已是囊中之物。死星的毁灭必将以血偿还。

en: The Rebel outpost has been discovered and will be destroyed. Galactic peace is at hand.
zh: 义军前哨站已被发现，即将被摧毁。银河和平近在眼前。

en: Palpatine's kidnapping gives the 501st a hands-on crash course in space combat.
zh: 帕尔帕廷遭绑架，给了501军团一场实战速成的太空战课程。

en: The droid presence here threatens the Republic cause. They must be destroyed.
zh: 这里的机器人威胁着共和国的事业。它们必须被消灭。

en: The CIS blockade on the Wookiee homeworld must be broken by any means necessary.
zh: 必须不惜一切手段打破分离势力对伍基人母星的封锁。

en: A fortified Wookiee refinery is the last defense against the planetary droid invasion.
zh: 一座坚固的伍基精炼厂是抵御机器人全面入侵的最后防线。

en: Ambushing General Grievous and his army will be the final crushing blow to the CIS.
zh: 伏击格里弗斯将军及其军队，将是对分离势力的最后一击。

en: The corrupt Jedi order must be wiped out, by Order 66 of the new Galactic Emperor.
zh: 腐败的绝地武士团必须被清除，遵照新银河皇帝的第66号命令。

en: The Queen of Naboo threatens the peace of the New Order. She must be silenced.
zh: 纳布女王威胁着新秩序的和平。她必须被消灭。

en: The Separatist threat is stirring again and lingers in orbit over Mustafar.
zh: 分离势力的威胁再次抬头，盘旋于穆斯塔法上空。

zh: 一个饱经战火摧残、沦为灰烬与废墟的工业世界。

zh: 一个遍布起伏平原与幽深沼泽湖泊的和平世界。

Unit Availablility
{OptionL} (3/3)
The infantry and pilot classes are always available to select in planetary and space battles, respectively. Marines and pilots appear only in space, while all other classes are exclusive to planetary battles.

en: A shadow looms over the Republic.  The Clone Wars have torn a rift across the Galaxy, its populace weak in allegiance and resolve.
zh: 阴影笼罩着共和国。克隆人战争在银河系撕开了一道裂痕，民众的忠诚与决心日渐薄弱。

en: SUPREME CHANCELLOR PALPATINE has commissioned an elite division of clone troopers, the 501st LEGION, to vanquish the Separatist threat once and for all.
zh: 最高议长帕尔帕廷组建了一支克隆人精锐部队——501军团，誓要一劳永逸地铲除分离势力的威胁。

en: Their unwavering loyalty to the Chancellor, combined with the Republic's desperation to see an end to the war, has set the stage for the execution of Palpatine's ultimate plan.
zh: 他们对议长坚定不移的忠诚，加上共和国渴望结束战争的迫切心情，为帕尔帕廷最终计划的实施铺平了道路。

en: Braving the frigid world of Mygeeto, the 501st joins Jedi Master Ki-Adi-Mundi for the first of many crucial battles destined to shape the fate of the galaxy..
zh: 在严寒的麦基托世界，501军团与绝地大师基-阿迪-芒迪并肩作战，这是注定将塑造银河系命运的多场关键战役中的第一场。

en: What I remember about the Rise of the Empire is, is how quiet it was.
zh: 我对帝国崛起的记忆，就是它有多么安静。

en: During the waning hours of the Clone Wars, the 501st Legion was discreetly transferred back to Coruscant.
zh: 在克隆人战争行将结束之际，501军团被秘密调回科洛桑。

en: We all knew what was about to happen, and what we were about to do.
zh: 我们都知道即将发生什么，也知道自己将要做什么。

en: Did we have any doubts, any private, traitorous thoughts?
zh: 我们有过疑虑、有过隐秘的背叛念头吗？

en: Perhaps, but no one said a word.
zh: 或许有，但没有人说一个字。

en: Not on the flight to Coruscant, not when Order 66 came down,
zh: 在飞往科洛桑的途中没有，当第66号指令下达时也没有，

en: and not when we marched into the Jedi Temple.
zh: 当我们踏进绝地圣殿时，依然没有人开口。

en: With the fall of Coruscant and the elimination of the traitorous Jedi,
zh: 随着科洛桑的陷落和叛徒绝地的清除，

en: Palpatine's rise to power was complete.
zh: 帕尔帕廷的权力之路就此圆满。

en: In recognition of our service and loyalty to the Emperor,
zh: 为表彰我们对皇帝的贡献与忠诚，

en: the 501st was placed under the direct command of Lord Vader.
zh: 501军团被置于维达勋爵的直接指挥之下。

en: Armed with deadly new weapons, blazing new ships and shiny new armor,
zh: 配备了致命的新武器、闪亮的新战舰和崭新的盔甲，

en: our presence let the galaxy know that the days of the Old Republic were well and truly over.
zh: 我们的存在让整个银河系明白，旧共和国的时代已彻底结束。

en: We were establishing a new era;
zh: 我们正在开创一个新时代；

en: an era of Order and Peace
zh: 一个秩序与和平的时代

en: Once it was finally finished, the Death Star, was the Emperor's favorite toy.
zh: 死星建成之后，成了皇帝最心爱的玩具。

en: It was also the most boring assignment in the galaxy for a stormtrooper.
zh: 对一名暴风兵来说，这也是整个银河系最无聊的差事。

en: Tedious inspection drills, endless hours of guarding impregnable force field generators.
zh: 枯燥的检查演练，没完没了地守卫固若金汤的力场发生器。

en: Things got so bad that, when a prison break erupted in the cell block,
zh: 情况糟到当监区发生越狱暴动时，

en: we were almost happy to have someone shooting at us again.
zh: 我们甚至几乎庆幸又有人朝我们开枪了。

en: If only we'd known what an embarrassing snipestorm we were about to wade into,
zh: 要是早知道我们即将陷入怎样一场难堪的狙击风暴，

en: we probably would've jettisoned the whole detention block into space.
zh: 我们大概会把整个监禁区直接扔进太空。

en: After the embarrassment of the prison break,
zh: 在越狱事件带来的难堪之后，

en: Lord Vader removed us from our comfortable billet,
zh: 维达勋爵把我们调离了舒适的驻地，

en: and began dragging the 501st across the galaxy
zh: 开始带着501军团辗转于银河各处，

en: in a dangerous hunt for the now-missing Death Star plans.
zh: 去危险地追查那份已经下落不明的死星设计图。

en: Ironically, our punishment eventually proved to be our salvation;
zh: 讽刺的是，这场惩罚最终竟成了我们的救赎；

en: the poor souls who took our place in the detention area
zh: 那些接替我们驻守监禁区的可怜家伙，

en: were completely wiped out when the Death Star was destroyed.
zh: 在死星被摧毁时全军覆没了。

en: It's been said that the 501st got the best of the war.
zh: 有人说，501军团在战争中得到了最好的一切。
我们也经历了最糟糕的一切。

en: On Felucia the Seps dug their metal heels into the muck of that alien hell hole,
zh: 在费卢西亚，分离势力的铁蹄深陷在那片外星地狱般的烂泥之中，

en: and dared the Republic to come in after them.
zh: 并向共和国叫嚣，看他们敢不敢追进来。

en: Only to be met with month after month of flesh eating diseases, shrieking nocturnal predators,
zh: 迎接我们的却是数月复数月的噬肉疾病、尖啸的夜行掠食者，

en: and other sites that haunt me to this day.
zh: 以及其他至今仍萦绕我心头的景象。

en: Cut off and, for all we knew, abandoned by our superiors, our only hope was,
zh: 与外界隔绝，而且在我们看来已被上级抛弃，我们唯一的希望就是，
我们的绝地指挥官——艾拉·塞库拉。

en: Without her iron will, none of us would have come out of that mess with our sanity, or our lives.
zh: 若不是她钢铁般的意志，我们谁都无法带着理智，甚至带着性命，走出那场混乱。

en: When her death came, I hope it was quick...
zh: 当她死去的时候，我希望那是干脆利落的……
她理应得到这样的结局。

en: When the 501st was finally rotated out of Felucia,
zh: 当501军团终于撤离费卢西亚时，

en: Aayla Secura made a point of seeing us off personally,
zh: 艾拉·塞库拉坚持亲自为我们送行，

en: calling us 'the bravest soldiers she'd ever seen.'
zh: 称我们为“她见过的最勇敢的士兵”。

en: It's a good thing we were wearing helmets, because none of us could bear to look her in the eye.
zh: 幸好我们都戴着头盔，因为我们谁都无法直视她的眼睛。

en: My first day as a member of the 501st
It was hot, it was sandy, chaotic, and nothing at all like the simulations on Kamino
zh: 那里炎热、黄沙漫天、混乱不堪，和卡米诺上的模拟训练完全不同

en: Of course, that's pretty much the way it was for all of us, wasn't it?
zh: 当然，我们所有人的经历大抵如此，不是吗？

en: All that breeding, all those years of training,
zh: 所有的基因培育，所有那些年的训练，

en: it doesn't really prepare you for all the screaming or the blood, does it?
zh: 并不能真正让你对满耳的惨叫和鲜血做好准备，不是吗？

en: Frankly, I'm still amazed we ever made it through the first hour,
zh: 说实话，我至今仍惊讶于我们竟能撑过最初的一个小时，

en: Incredibly, the 501st survived the crucible of Geonosis,
zh: 不可思议的是，501军团经受住了吉奥诺西斯的严酷考验，

en: emerging battle-hardened and ready for whatever the war would throw at us.
zh: 百战余生，准备迎接战争抛给我们的任何挑战。

en: No one ever complained about the cold on Hoth.
zh: 在霍斯，从没有人抱怨过寒冷。

en: Even though we were blinded by blizzards,
zh: 即使暴风雪遮蔽了我们的视线，

en: we could see the final end of the Rebellion in our blaster sights.
zh: 我们也能在爆能枪的准星中看到义军的末日。

en: on that planet, our blood ran hot with dreams of victory,
zh: 在那颗行星上，胜利的梦想令我们热血沸腾，

en: melting the ice that stood in our way.
zh: 融化了挡在面前的寒冰。

en: the 501st gathered around a burning bunker,
zh: 501军团聚集在一座燃烧的碉堡周围，

en: and let out a cheer that shook the stars.
zh: 发出了震动星辰的欢呼。

en: The Death Star was being rebuilt, bigger than ever.
zh: 死星正在重建，比以往任何时候都更加庞大。

en: Order had finally returned to the galaxy,
zh: 秩序终于回到了银河系，

en: in no small part due to the efforts
zh: 这在很大程度上归功于

en: Officially, there never was a 'Clone Rebellion' on Kamino.
zh: 官方说法是，卡米诺从未发生过所谓的“克隆人叛乱”。

en: Unofficially, approximately twenty years after we were created, a special detachment of the Imperial 501st Legion was dispatched to Kamino,
zh: 但事实上，在我们被创造出来大约二十年后，帝国501军团的一支特遣队被派往卡米诺，

en: a special detachment of the Imperial 501st Legion was dispatched to Kamino,
zh: 帝国501军团的一支特遣队被派往卡米诺，

en: with orders to eradicate an army of clones that had been bred to take arms against the Empire.
zh: 奉命剿灭一支被培育起来、准备武装对抗帝国的克隆人军队。

en: Our mission commander, an expert on the inner workings of Kamino, was a young bounty hunter named
zh: 我们的任务指挥官，一位对卡米诺内部运作了如指掌的专家，是一名年轻的赏金猎人，名叫

en: The bounty hunter left after the battle was over.
zh: 战斗结束后，那位赏金猎人便离开了。

en: Said something about tracking down a smuggler on Tatooine.
zh: 说是要去塔图因追查一名走私犯。

en:
After the Kamino uprising, the Emperor decided that an army of genetically identical 
soldiers was too susceptible to corruption;
zh:
卡米诺起义之后，皇帝认定，一支基因完全相同的
士兵军队太容易被腐化；

en: future troopers would be cloned from a variety of templates.
zh: 未来的士兵将取自多种不同的基因模板进行克隆。
尽管501军团依旧保持纯正，

en: the rest of the Imperial Army gradually became more and more diverse.
zh: 帝国军的其余部队却逐渐变得日益混杂。

en: We never really got used to the new guys.
zh: 我们始终不太习惯那些新兵。

en: things were just as bad as we'd feared.
zh: 情况正如我们所担心的那样糟糕。
机器人的火力压倒了我们，

en: outmaneuvered, and outmanned by a five-to-one margin.
zh: 战术上胜过我们，兵力更是以五比一占优。

en: What none of us had counted on
zh: 我们谁都没有料到的是

en: We'd all heard the stories, of course,
zh: 当然，我们都听过那些传说，

en: but we'd never fought next to them.
zh: 但我们从未与他们并肩作战过。

en: Never seen them rip apart a droid with their bare hands.
zh: 从未见过他们赤手空拳撕碎一台机器人。

en: Even so, it was still a suicide mission.
zh: 即便如此，这仍是一次自杀式任务。

en: At least, it was until Master Yoda arrived.
zh: 至少，在尤达大师到来之前是这样的。
之后，它变成了一场真正的战斗。

en: With the timely arrival of Master Yoda,
zh: 得益于尤达大师的及时到来，

en: the 501st was able to hold the line against the Seps on Kashyyyk.
zh: 501军团得以在卡希克抵挡住分离势力的进攻。
我们以英雄之姿离开了卡希克。
多年以后，我们会重返此地，

en: By the time we'd made our way to the molten surface of Mustafar,
zh: 当我们抵达穆斯塔法熔岩翻涌的地表时，

en: it was apparent that Delso had been a busy little bug.
zh: 很明显，德尔索这个小虫子可没闲着。

en: All by his lonesome he'd found a previously-hidden droid factory,
zh: 他独自一人找到了一座此前隐藏的机器人工厂，

en: fired it up, and cranked out his own private army of battle droids.
zh: 将其启动，造出了属于自己的私人战斗机器人军队。

en: Needless to say, this got the men of the 501st a little hot under the helmet,
zh: 不用说，这让501军团的弟兄们头盔底下直冒火，

en: and not just because of all the lava.
zh: 而且不只是因为满地的熔岩。

en: Truth be told, we'd all had our fill of those gearheads during the war,
zh: 说实话，战争期间我们早已受够了那些铁脑壳，

en: and couldn't stomach the thought of going through another one.  So we blew them up.
zh: 再也无法忍受再来一次的想法。于是我们把他们炸了个稀巴烂。

en: Blew up the droids, blew up the factory, damn near blew up the planet.
zh: 炸掉了机器人，炸掉了工厂，差点把整颗行星都炸了。

en: The destruction of the mining facility put an end to any thoughts of a second droid rebellion.
zh: 采矿设施的毁灭，彻底打消了任何第二次机器人叛乱的念头。

en: For the first time in years, the men of the 501st could relax,
zh: 多年来，501军团的弟兄们第一次得以放松，

en: and get about the business of maintaining an Empire,
zh: 着手于维系帝国的事务，

en: In the waning months of the Clone Wars,
zh: 在克隆人战争行将结束的几个月里，

en: the 501st faced missions critical to the agenda of Chancellor Palpatine.
zh: 501军团承担了对帕尔帕廷议长议程至关重要的任务。

en: When we arrived at the bombed-out ruins of Mygeeto,
zh: 当我们抵达被炸成废墟的麦基托时，

en: our Jedi Commander believed we had been sent to take out a droid energy collector.
zh: 我们的绝地指挥官以为我们是被派来摧毁一台机器人能量收集器的。
基-阿迪-芒迪不知道的是，

en: however, was that our unit of the 501st
zh: 其实我们这支501军团的分队，

en: was really after an experimental Mygeetan power source
zh: 真正的目标是麦基托的一种实验性能源，

en: that the Chancellor wanted for his 'superlaser.'
zh: 那是议长想要用来制造他的“超级激光炮”的。

en: Keeping Mundi in the dark wasn't easy;
the Jedi had become increasingly wary of the Chancellor's doings,
zh: 绝地们对议长的所作所为越来越警觉，

en: and were on the lookout for the slightest hint of treachery.
zh: 时刻提防着任何一丝背叛的迹象。

en: Just like the rest of them, though,
he never caught a whiff of what was really going on
zh: 他始终没有察觉到真正发生的事情，

en: until it was far too late.
The success of the mission on Mygeeto
was something of a revelation for the men of the 501st.
zh: 对501军团的弟兄们来说，不啻于一种启示。

en: Suddenly, we realized that the Jedi could be fooled.
zh: 突然间，我们意识到，绝地也是可以被蒙骗的。

en: And if they could be fooled,
During the Rise of the Empire,
the Emperor's home planet of Naboo
rapidly established itself as a major irritant.
zh: 迅速成了帝国的一大眼中钉。

en: After a number of Naboo's ambassadors were sent home
zh: 数位纳布大使被遣送回国，

en: her newly-elected Queen broke off diplomatic ties
zh: 新当选的女王断绝了与帝国的外交关系，

en: Clearly, it was time for a regime change;
zh: 显然，是时候进行一次政权更迭了；

en: a change that would be affected by the 501st,
zh: 这场更迭将由501军团来执行，

en: now under the direct command of Darth Vader.
zh: 这支军团现在直接受达斯·维达指挥。

en: sending a clear signal to other potential troublemakers
zh: 向帝国内其他潜在的不安定分子
纳布迅速顺从了帝国的意志。

en: It was the first time the 501st was called upon to 'adjust' a planet's government,
zh: 这是501军团第一次受命去“调整”一颗行星的政府，

en: but it wouldn't be the last.
Within months the 501st gained a well-deserved reputation
zh: 短短几个月内，501军团就赢得了当之无愧的威名

en: By the time of the raid on Polis Massa,
zh: 到突袭波利斯·马萨的时候，

en: the men of the 501st were starting to get a little sick of this so-called 'Rebellion.'
zh: 501军团的弟兄们开始对这场所谓的“叛乱”感到有些厌烦了。

en: In the past, we'd secretly enjoyed putting down a local insurrection or two;
zh: 过去，我们还会暗自享受镇压一两次地方暴乱的快感；

en: they kept the troops sharp and the Empire feared.
zh: 那能让部队保持锐气，也能让帝国令人畏惧。

en: They were organized, they were growing, and they were everywhere.
zh: 他们有组织、在壮大，而且无处不在。

en: The raid on Polis Massa was a perfect example of how things were starting to fall apart.
zh: 波利斯·马萨突袭战就是局势开始失控的绝佳例证。

en: We were supposed to go in, wipe out a small band of Rebels,
zh: 我们本应进入，消灭一小股义军，

en: and recover some stolen Imperial plans on an encrypted holodisk.
zh: 并找回记录在一张加密全息碟上的被盗帝国设计图。

en: Before we knew it, we were nearly overrun by Rebel forces,
zh: 可转眼之间，我们就被义军部队打得几乎溃不成军，

en: with the holodisk nowhere to be found.
zh: 而那盘全息碟却遍寻无果。

en: Even though the Polis Massa raid was only a partial success,
zh: 尽管波利斯·马萨突袭战只算部分成功，

en: we finally had a lead on the whereabouts of the Death Star plans,
zh: 我们终于掌握了死星设计图下落的线索，
随着克隆人战争的推进，

en: more and more ground-based legions found themselves pressed into space combat,
zh: 越来越多的地面军团被迫投入太空作战，

en: including the fighting forces of the 501st.
For months, every hour of our downtime was spent in the simulator,
zh: 数月以来，我们所有的休息时间都泡在模拟器里，

en: preparing for the time we would face our enemies from the cockpit of a 170.
zh: 为日后驾驶170型战机在座舱中直面敌人做准备。

en: Finally the day came to earn our wings.
zh: 终于，展翅翱翔的日子来临了。

en: The CIS had staged a daring kidnapping of Chancellor Palpatine,
zh: 分离势力胆大包天，绑架了帕尔帕廷议长，

en: and was being escorted from Coruscant by a fleet of Separatist ships.
zh: 他正被一支分离势力的舰队从科洛桑押送离开。

en: With only a few veteran pilots on-planet,
zh: 由于行星上只有寥寥数名资深飞行员，

en: many of the 501st were pressed into service to drive off the Seps,
zh: 501军团中许多人被紧急征召投入战斗，以击退分离势力，

en: and buy time for a pair of Jedi Knights to rescue the Chancellor.
zh: 为两位绝地武士营救议长争取时间。

en: After disabling the final capital ship,
zh: 在瘫痪了最后一艘主力舰之后，

en: General Kenobi and Skywalker took advantage of the opportunity we'd created,
zh: 克诺比将军与天行者抓住了我们创造的机会，

en: When the Separatist invasion of Kashyyyk caught the Republic flatfooted,
zh: 当分离势力入侵卡希克、打得共和国措手不及时，

en: a detachment of the 501st was sent in to stop the bleeding until reinforcements could arrive.
zh: 501军团的一支分队被派去稳住局面，等待增援抵达。

en: It was a textbook suicide mission, and we knew it.
zh: 这是一次教科书式的自杀任务，我们心知肚明。

en: As we fought our way into Kashyyyk's atmosphere,
zh: 当我们一路奋战冲入卡希克的大气层时，

en: most of us believed that the only way we'd be getting off this planet was in a body bag.
zh: 我们中大多数人相信，离开这颗行星的唯一方式就是被装进尸袋。

en: As the 501st finally broke through the Sep blockade over Kashyyyk,
zh: 当501军团终于突破卡希克上空的分离势力封锁时，

en: I took a long look back at the battle that continued to rage over the planet,
zh: 我久久回望着行星上空仍在激烈进行的战斗，

en: and wondered why so many had to die for a bunch of walking carpets.
zh: 不禁疑惑，为什么这么多人要为一群会走路的毛毯送命。

en: Then I followed my orders, and turned planetward.
zh: 随后我遵从命令，转向行星方向。

en: Although the Clone Wars were over,
zh: 尽管克隆人战争已经结束，

en: some people never seemed to get the message.
zh: 有些人却似乎始终没有领会其中的含义。

en: The worst case of denial was Gizor Delso,
zh: 最执迷不悟的就是吉佐·德尔索，

en: a Geonosian Separatist who'd somehow escaped Lord Vader's efforts to wipe out
zh: 一名吉奥诺西斯分离主义者，他不知怎么逃脱了维达勋爵清剿

en: Lord Vader tracked him to Mustafar, and brought us in to finish the job.
zh: 维达勋爵一路追踪他到穆斯塔法，并调我们来完成收尾工作。

en: It seemed like a simple enough mission,
zh: 这看起来是一次再简单不过的任务，

en: but we saw the fleet of droid ships hovering over the planet,
zh: 可当我们看到悬停在行星上空的机器人舰队时，

en: we suddenly realized that Delso's denial mechanisms
zh: 我们突然意识到，德尔索的负隅顽抗

en: were a little more dangerous than we'd imagined.
zh: 比我们想象的要危险得多。

en: The slight whiff of nostalgia the 501st had enjoyed fighting the droid fleet over Mustafar
zh: 501军团在穆斯塔法上空与机器人舰队交战时的那点怀旧感，

en: had already grown sour by the time we'd established orbital positions.
zh: 到我们进入轨道阵位时，早已变了味。

en: Now it was time to find out what this was all about.
zh: 现在，是时候弄清楚这一切到底是怎么回事了。

en: When the Death Star was destroyed,
about half of 501st Legion was still in the hangar, getting into their ships.
zh: 501军团大约一半的人还在机库里，正准备登机。

en: Of those who made it out, another third were caught in the explosion.
zh: 在侥幸逃出的人中，又有三分之一被爆炸波及。

en: I'd fought with some of those men for over twenty years.
zh: 我和其中一些人并肩作战超过二十年了。

en: Afterwards, those of us that survived hooked up with a nearby
zh: 事后，我们这些幸存者与附近的一支

en: Imperial fleet making a retaliatory strike on the Rebel's base on Yavin 4.
zh: 帝国舰队会合，对雅文4号上的义军基地发动报复性打击。

en: It wasn't the best thought-out plan, but we were cut-off from our leaders,
zh: 这个计划算不上深思熟虑，但我们与指挥官失去了联系，
疲惫不堪，只能凭本能行事。

en: If not for our training, we probably would never gotten past their orbital defenses.
zh: 若不是依靠平日的训练，我们恐怕根本无法突破他们的轨道防御。

en: And so the battle over Yavin came to an end.
zh: 雅文上空的战斗就这样结束了。

en: I'm told we destroyed hundreds of Rebel ships that day.
zh: 据说那一天我们摧毁了数百艘义军战舰。

en: Even if it had been thousands,
it wouldn't have made up for the Death Star.
zh: 也无法弥补死星的损失。

en: As the Clone Wars progressed, more and more ground-based legions found themselves pressed into space combat, including the fighting forces of the 501st.  For months, every hour of our downtime was spent in the simulator, preparing for the time we would face our enemies from the cockpit of a 170.  Finally the day came to earn our wings.  The CIS had staged a daring kidnapping of Chancellor Palpatine, and was being escorted from Coruscant by a fleet of Separatist ships.
zh: 随着克隆人战争的推进，越来越多的地面军团被迫投入太空作战，501军团的作战部队也不例外。数月以来，我们所有的休息时间都泡在模拟器里，为日后驾驶170型战机在座舱中直面敌人做准备。终于，展翅翱翔的日子来临了。分离势力胆大包天，绑架了帕尔帕廷议长，他正被一支分离势力的舰队从科洛桑押送离开。

en: With the information gathered on Polis Massa,
zh: 凭借在波利斯·马萨收集到的情报，

en: Vader concluded that the stolen plans
zh: 维达断定，被盗的设计图

en: had been given to Princess Leia Organa of Alderaan.
zh: 已经被交给了奥德朗的莱娅·奥加纳公主。

en: for all their talk of being a 'peaceful planet,'
zh: 尽管奥德朗口口声声自称“和平星球”，

en: Alderaan had been thumbing its nose at the Empire for years.
zh: 多年来，奥德朗却一直在公然藐视帝国。

en: After a brief and pointless battle,
zh: 在一场短暂而无谓的战斗之后，

en: we boarded the ship, the Tantive IV, over Tatooine.
zh: 我们在塔图因上空登上了那艘船——坦蒂夫四号。

en: and waited for Lord Vader's arrival.
zh: 并等待维达勋爵的到来。

en: After Lord Vader took custody of Princess Leia,
zh: 维达勋爵接管莱娅公主之后，

en: we all figured it was just a matter of time before she coughed up the plans.
zh: 我们都以为她招供设计图的下落只是时间问题。

en: Many of us had been unwilling witnesses to Vader's powers
zh: 我们中许多人曾被迫亲眼目睹过维达

en: the thought of a pampered little princess resisting his terrible will
zh: 一个娇生惯养的小公主竟能抗拒他那可怕的意志，

en: Welcome to space combat training, cadet.
zh: 欢迎来到太空战斗训练，学员。

en: If you hope to return in one piece, you'd better know the basics of starfighter control.
zh: 如果你还想囫囵个儿地回来，就最好掌握星际战斗机的基本操控。

en: Your cruiser is under attack!  Jump into any STARFIGHTER and LAUNCH from the HANGAR.
zh: 你的巡洋舰正遭到攻击！登上任意一架星际战斗机，从机库出发！

en: Use the THROTTLE to accelerate through space, or to slow down as you approach a hangar.
zh: 使用油门在太空中加速，或在接近机库时减速。

en: Time is of the essence, so all ships are equipped with BOOST for a burst of speed.
zh: 时间紧迫，所有战机都配备了加速功能，可瞬间提升速度。

en: Don't let the enemy get away!  Activate TARGET TRACKING to follow their movements.
zh: 别让敌人跑掉！启动目标追踪，锁定他们的行踪。

en: They can run, but they can't hide.
zh: 他们可以逃，但逃不过追踪。

en: The DISTANCE indicator will tell you how far away the enemy is,
zh: 距离指示器会告诉你敌人有多远，

en: and whether they are above or below you.
zh: 以及他们是在你的上方还是下方。

en: Clever pilots always LOCK-ON to the enemy!
zh: 聪明的飞行员总是会锁定敌人！

en: Missiles will SEEK a locked target.  This is the best way to dispatch a foe.
zh: 导弹会追踪已锁定的目标。这是解决敌人的最佳方式。

en: Use BOMBERS wisely to disable enemy shields and other hard targets along the exterior.
zh: 明智地使用轰炸机，摧毁敌方护盾及舰体外部其他坚固目标。

en: Land in the enemy Hangar to attack where they are most vulnerable.
zh: 降落在敌方机库中，攻击他们最脆弱的地方。

en: Take them by surprise by bringing a squad of reinforcements in your TRANSPORT.
zh: 用运输船载入一队增援，出其不意地打击敌人。

en: Your snub fighters are no match for the might of a fully armed capital ship.
zh: 你的小型战斗机无法与全副武装的主力舰抗衡。

en: Crafty pilots will even the odds with a bit of sabotage.
zh: 狡猾的飞行员会通过一点破坏来扭转局势。

en: Strike the key systems from within.  A TIMEBOMB or ROCKET will make short work of those targets.
zh: 从内部打击关键系统。定时炸弹或火箭弹能迅速解决这些目标。

en: Now you know what it takes to survive in Space.
zh: 现在你知道了在太空中生存所需的技巧。

en: For further instruction in the cockpit and a taste of real combat, play Rise of the Empire.
zh: 如需更多座舱内的指导，并体验真正的战斗，请游玩“帝国的崛起”。

en: Good Luck Cadet, and may the Force be with you.
zh: 祝你好运，学员，愿原力与你同在。

en: In our bones, we knew the war was almost over.
zh: 我们打心底里知道，战争已近尾声。

en: The galaxy held its breath, waiting to see which side would make the final, daring move.
zh: 银河系屏息凝神，等待着看哪一方会迈出最后的、大胆的一步。

en: As fortune would have it, the Republic moved first.
zh: 幸运的是，共和国率先行动了。

en: After the Chancellor informed the Jedi Council that General Grievous
zh: 当议长告知绝地委员会，格里弗斯将军

en: and the Sep leaders were hiding on Utapau,
zh: 与分离势力头目正藏匿在尤塔帕时，

en: General Kenobi gathered an army 'large enough to capture three star systems,
zh: 克诺比将军集结了一支“足以征服三个星系”的军队，

en: When the orders reached the 501st, our morale soared;
zh: 当命令传到501军团时，我们的士气高涨；

en: for better or worse, this would be the beginning of the end.
zh: 无论结果如何，这都将成为终结的开端。

en: With the death of General Grievous at the hands of General Kenobi,
zh: 格里弗斯将军命丧克诺比将军之手后，

en: the Utapau raid had broken the back of the Separatists.
zh: 尤塔帕突袭战彻底击垮了分离势力的脊梁。

en: Under normal circumstances, it would have been a time for celebration.
zh: 按照常理，这本该是庆祝的时刻。

en: But our next orders put paid to those thoughts.
zh: 但我们接下来的命令，让这些念头化为泡影。

en: By the time we'd landed on Yavin,
whatever shock we'd felt at the destruction of the Death Star
zh: 死星被摧毁带给我们的震惊，

en: For months we'd treated the Rebellion like a disobedient child,
zh: 数月以来，我们对待义军就像对待一个不听话的孩子，

en: only to be repaid for our tolerance with treachery on an unimaginable scale.
zh: 而我们的宽容换来的，却是他们难以想象的背叛行径。

en: Frankly, I don't remember much of the fighting.
zh: 说实话，战斗的细节我已记不太清。

en: After the battle, the surviving members of the 501st finally caught their breath.
zh: 战斗结束后，501军团的幸存者们终于得以喘息。

en: The Empire had taken the Rebels' best shot, and come up standing.
zh: 帝国承受住了义军最猛烈的打击，依然屹立不倒。

en: Now it was our turn to strike.

What I remember about the Rise of the Empire is, is how quiet it was.  During the waning hours of the Clone Wars, the 501st Legion was discreetly transferred back to Coruscant.  It was a silent trip.  We all knew what was about to happen, and what we were about to do.  Did we have any doubts, any private, traitorous thoughts?  Perhaps, but no one said a word.  Not on the flight to Coruscant, not when Order 66 came down, and not when we marched into the Jedi Temple.  Not a word.
zh: 我对帝国崛起的记忆，就是它有多么安静。在克隆人战争行将结束之际，501军团被秘密调回科洛桑。那是一段寂静的旅程。我们都知道即将发生什么，也知道自己将要做什么。我们有过疑虑、有过隐秘的背叛念头吗？或许有，但没有人说一个字。在飞往科洛桑的途中没有，当第66号指令下达时也没有，当我们踏进绝地圣殿时，依然没有人开口。一个字都没有。

en: We marched out of the Jedi Temple as quietly as we'd arrived.  Our job was done, the Jedi Conspirators were dead.  Out of such silences are empires born.
zh: 我们像抵达时一样悄无声息地走出了绝地圣殿。我们的任务完成了，绝地阴谋家们已经伏诛。帝国，正是诞生于这样的寂静之中。

en: With the fall of Coruscant and the elimination of the traitorous Jedi, Palpatine's rise to power was complete.  In recognition of our service and loyalty to the Emperor, the 501st was placed under the direct command of Lord Vader.  Armed with deadly new weapons, blazing new ships and shiny new armor, our presence let the galaxy know that the days of the Old Republic were well and truly over.  We were establishing a new era; an era of Order and Peace
zh: 随着科洛桑的陷落和叛徒绝地的清除，帕尔帕廷的权力之路就此圆满。为表彰我们对皇帝的贡献与忠诚，501军团被置于维达勋爵的直接指挥之下。配备了致命的新武器、闪亮的新战舰和崭新的盔甲，我们的存在让整个银河系明白，旧共和国的时代已彻底结束。我们正在开创一个新时代；一个秩序与和平的时代

en: A long time ago in a galaxy far, far away....
zh: 很久很久以前，在一个遥远的星系……

en:
Fall of the Old Republic

A shadow looms over the Republic.  The Clone Wars have torn a rift across the Galaxy, its populace weak in allegiance and resolve.

SUPREME CHANCELLOR PALPATINE has commissioned an elite division of clone troopers, the 501st LEGION, to vanquish the Separatist threat once and for all.  Their unwavering loyalty to the Chancellor, combined with the Republic's desperation to see an end to the war, has set the stage for the execution of Palpatine's ultimate plan.

Braving the frigid world of Mygeeto, the 501st joins Jedi Master Ki-Adi-Mundi for the first of many crucial battles destined to shape the fate of the galaxy..
zh:
旧共和国的陨落

阴影笼罩着共和国。克隆人战争已在银河系中撕裂出一道裂痕，民众的忠诚与意志日益薄弱。

最高议长帕尔帕廷组建了一支克隆人精英部队——第501军团，誓要一举铲除分离势力的威胁。他们对议长坚定不移的忠诚，加上共和国渴望终结战争的迫切心情，为帕尔帕廷终极计划的实施铺平了道路。

第501军团冒着麦基托的凛冽严寒，与绝地大师基-阿迪-芒迪并肩作战，这注定是决定银河系命运的多场关键战役中的第一场。

en: Once it was finally finished, the Death Star, was the Emperor's favorite toy.  It was also the most boring assignment in the galaxy for a stormtrooper.  Tedious inspection drills, endless hours of guarding impregnable force field generators. it was all the 501st could do to keep from banging their heads against the walls.  Things got so bad that, when a prison break erupted in the cell block reserved for 'political malcontents', we were almost happy to have someone shooting at us again.  If only we'd known what an embarrassing snipestorm we were about to wade into, we probably would've jettisoned the whole detention block into space.
zh: 死星建成之后，就成了皇帝最心爱的玩具。但对于冲锋队员来说，这也是银河系中最无聊的任务。枯燥的检查演习、无休止地看守固若金汤的力场发生器，第501军团光是忍住不拿脑袋撞墙就已经竭尽全力了。情况糟到极点时，当关押“政治异见分子”的监区爆发越狱事件，我们甚至庆幸终于又有人朝我们开枪了。要是早知道我们将陷入怎样一场难堪的风暴，我们大概会把整个拘留区直接扔进太空。

en: After the embarrassment of the prison break, Lord Vader removed us from our comfortable billet, and began dragging the 501st across the galaxy in a dangerous hunt for the now-missing Death Star plans.   Ironically, our punishment eventually proved to be our salvation; the poor bastards who took our place in the detention area were completely wiped out when the Death Star was destroyed.
zh: 越狱事件带来的难堪过后，维达大人把我们调离了舒适的营房，开始率领第501军团踏遍银河，追查那批已经不翼而飞的死星设计图。讽刺的是，这次惩罚最终竟成了我们的救赎；那些接替我们驻守拘留区的倒霉蛋，在死星被摧毁时全军覆没。

en: When the 501st was finally rotated out of Felucia, Aayla Secura made a point of seeing us off personally, calling us 'the bravest soldiers she'd ever seen.'  It's a good thing we were wearing helmets, because none of us could bear to look her in the eye.
zh: 当第501军团终于从费卢西亚轮换撤离时，艾拉·塞库拉特意亲自为我们送行，称我们是“她见过的最勇敢的士兵”。幸好我们戴着头盔，因为我们谁都不忍直视她的眼睛。

en: When we were finally rotated out of Felucia, Aayla Secura made a point of seeing us off personally, calling us 'the bravest soldiers she'd ever seen.'  At the time, it was the proudest moment of the 501st's increasingly storied history.  Funny how the years can turn pride to shame.
zh: 当我们终于从费卢西亚轮换撤离时，艾拉·塞库拉特意亲自为我们送行，称我们是“她见过的最勇敢的士兵”。那一刻，是第501军团日益传奇的历史中最引以为傲的时刻。可笑的是，岁月竟能把骄傲变成耻辱。

en: My first day as a member of the 501st, it was hot, it was sandy, chaotic, and nothing at all like the simulations on Kamino.  Of course, that's pretty much the way it was for all of us, wasn't it?  All that breeding, all those years of training, it doesn't really prepare you for all the screaming or the blood, does it?  Frankly, I'm still amazed we ever made it through the first hour, never mind the first day.
zh: 我加入第501军团的第一天，酷热、风沙、混乱，和卡米诺上的模拟训练完全是两回事。当然，我们所有人差不多都是这样过来的，不是吗？那些基因培育，那些年复一年的训练，根本没法让你准备好面对那些尖叫和鲜血，对吧？说实话，我至今仍惊叹于我们竟能撑过第一个小时，更别提第一天了。

en: Incredibly, the 501st survived the crucible of Geonosis, emerging battle-hardened and ready for whatever the war would throw at us.
zh: 难以置信，第501军团竟从吉奥诺西斯这场炼狱中幸存下来，变得久经沙场，准备好迎接战争抛来的任何考验。

en: No one ever complained about the cold on Hoth.  We never felt it.  Even though we were blinded by blizzards, we could see the final end of the Rebellion in our blaster sights.  Was it only a mirage?  Perhaps.  But on that day, on that planet, our blood ran hot with dreams of victory, melting the ice that stood in our way.
zh: 在霍斯，从没有人抱怨过寒冷。我们从未感觉到它。尽管暴风雪遮蔽了视线，我们依然能从爆能枪的准星中看到义军的末日。那只是海市蜃楼吗？也许吧。但在那一天，在那颗星球上，我们的热血因胜利的梦想而沸腾，融化了挡在面前的坚冰。

en: As the Rebels fled, the 501st gathered around a burning bunker, and let out a cheer that shook the stars.  The Rebellion was done.  The Death Star was being rebuilt, bigger than ever.  Order had finally returned to the galaxy, in no small part due to the efforts of the fighting men of the 501st.
zh: 义军仓皇逃窜之际，第501军团围聚在一座燃烧的碉堡旁，爆发出震彻群星的欢呼。义军完了。死星正在重建，规模空前。秩序终于重归银河系，这在很大程度上要归功于第501军团战士们的奋战。

en: It's been said that the 501st got the best of the war.  We also got the worst.  On Felucia, the Seps dug their metal heels into the muck of that alien hellhole and dared the Republic to come in after them.  So we did, only to be met with month after month of flesh-eating diseases, shrieking nocturnal predators, and other sights that haunt me to this day.  Cut off and for all we knew abandoned by our superiors, our only hope was Aayla Secura, our Jedi Commander.  Without her iron will, none of us would have come out of that mess with our sanity or our lives.  When her death came, I hope it was quick.she'd earned that much.
zh: 有人说第501军团在战争中捞到了最好的差事。我们也尝过最糟的。在费卢西亚，分离势力的金属脚跟深陷那片外星地狱的泥沼，挑衅着共和国来追击他们。我们照做了，迎来的却是一个又一个月的噬肉疾病、彻夜尖啸的掠食者，以及其他至今仍萦绕在我心头的景象。与外界隔绝，甚至可能已被上级抛弃，我们唯一的希望就是我们的绝地指挥官艾拉·塞库拉。没有她钢铁般的意志，我们没人能神志健全地活着走出那片泥潭。当她死去时，我希望那是瞬间的事——她应得这样的结局。

en: Officially, there never was a 'Clone Rebellion' on Kamino.  Unofficially, approximately twenty years after we were created, a special detachment of the Imperial 501st Legion was dispatched to Kamino, with orders to eradicate an army of clones that had been bred to take arms against the Empire.    Our mission commander, an expert on the inner workings of Kamino, was a young bounty hunter named Boba Fett.
zh: 官方说法是，卡米诺上从未发生过“克隆人叛乱”。而实际上，在我们被创造出来大约二十年后，一支帝国第501军团的特遣队被派往卡米诺，奉命剿灭一支被培育出来武装反抗帝国的克隆人军队。我们的任务指挥官，一位精通卡米诺内部运作的专家，是个名叫波巴·费特的年轻赏金猎人。

en: After the Kamino uprising, the Emperor decided that an army of genetically identical soldiers was too susceptible to corruption; future troopers would be cloned from a variety of templates.  Though the 501st itself remained pure, the rest of the Imperial Army gradually became more and more diverse.  We never really got used to the new guys.
zh: 卡米诺叛乱之后，皇帝断定基因完全相同的士兵军团太容易被腐化；未来的士兵将从多种模板克隆而来。尽管第501军团本身保持纯粹，帝国军的其他部队却逐渐变得愈发庞杂。我们始终没能真正习惯那些新面孔。

en: The bounty hunter left after the battle was over.  Said something about tracking down a smuggler on Tattooine.  After the Kamino uprising, the Emperor decided that an army of genetically identical soldiers was too susceptible to corruption; future trooper would be cloned from a variety of templates.   Though the 501st remained pure, the rest of the Imperial Army gradually became more and more diverse.  We never really got used to the new guys.
zh: 战斗结束后，那个赏金猎人便离开了。说是要去塔图因追查一个走私贩。卡米诺叛乱之后，皇帝断定基因完全相同的士兵军团太容易被腐化；未来的士兵将从多种模板克隆而来。尽管第501军团保持纯粹，帝国军的其他部队却逐渐变得愈发庞杂。我们始终没能真正习惯那些新面孔。

en: When we arrive on Kashyyk, things were just as bad as we'd feared. The droids had us outgunned, outmaneuvered, and outmanned by a five-to-one margin.  What none of us had counted on was the Wookiees.  We'd all heard the stories, of course, but we'd never fought next to them.  Never seen them rip apart a droid with their bare hands.they were magnificent.  Even so, it was still a suicide mission.  At least, it was until Master Yoda arrived.  Then it became a battle.  A winnable battle
zh: 当我们抵达卡希克时，情况果然和我们担心的一样糟。机器人在火力、战术和兵力上都以五比一的优势压制我们。谁都没有料到的是伍基人。那些传说我们当然都听过，但我们从未和他们并肩作战过。从未见过他们徒手把机器人撕成碎片——他们实在太强悍了。即便如此，这仍是一场自杀式任务。至少，在尤达大师到来之前是这样。他来了之后，这场战斗才变成一场战役。一场可以打赢的战役。

en: With the timely arrival of Master Yoda, the 501st was able to hold the line against the Seps on Kashyyyk.  We left as heroes.  Years later, we'd return as conquerors.
zh: 得益于尤达大师的及时到来，第501军团在卡希克顶住了分离势力的攻势。我们作为英雄离开了那里。多年之后，我们将以征服者的身份重返。

en: By the time we'd made our way to the molten surface of Mustafar, it was apparent that Dellso had been a busy little bug.  All by his lonesome he'd found a previously-hidden droid factory, fired it up, and cranked out his own private army of battle droids.  Needless to say, this got the men of the 501st a little hot under the helmet, and not just because of all the lava.  Truth be told, we'd all had our fill of those gearheads during the war, and couldn't stomach the thought of going through another one.  So we blew them up.  Blew up the droids, blew up the factory, damn near blew up the planet.
zh: 等我们踏上穆斯塔法熔融的地表时，很明显德尔索这个讨厌的小虫子一直没闲着。他孤身一人找到了一座藏匿的机器人工厂，把它重新启动，造出了自己私人的战斗机器人军队。不用说，这让第501军团的弟兄们头盔底下火冒三丈——不只是因为满地的岩浆。说实话，战争期间我们早就受够了那些铁疙瘩，实在无法忍受再来一场的想法。所以我们把它们炸上了天。炸掉机器人，炸掉工厂，差点把整颗星球都炸飞。

en: The destruction of the mining facility put an end to any thoughts of a second droid rebellion.  For the first time in years, the men of the 501st could relax, and get about the business of maintaining an Empire, rather than building one.
zh: 采矿设施的毁灭终结了任何第二次机器人叛乱的念头。多年来，第501军团的弟兄们头一次能放松下来，着手维护一个帝国，而不是去建设一个。

en: In the waning months of the Clone Wars, the 501st faced missions critical to the agenda of Chancellor Palpatine.  When we arrived at the bombed-out ruins of Mygeeto, our Jedi Commander believed we had been sent to take out a droid energy collector.  What Ki-Adi-Mundi didn't know, however, was that our unit of the 501st was really after an experimental Mygeetan power source that the Chancellor wanted for his 'superlaser.'  Keeping Mundi in the dark wasn't easy; the Jedi had become increasingly wary of the Chancellor's doings, and were on the lookout for the slightest hint of treachery.  Just like the rest of them, though, he never caught a whiff of what was really going on until it was far too late.
zh: 在克隆人战争步入尾声的几个月里，第501军团面临的任务对帕尔帕廷议长的图谋至关重要。当我们抵达麦基托被炸毁的废墟时，我们的绝地指挥官以为我们是来摧毁一个机器人能量收集器的。然而基-阿迪-芒迪不知道的是，我们这支第501军团部队真正的目标是麦基托的一种实验性能源，那是议长想要用来建造他的“超级激光炮”的。瞒着芒迪并不容易；绝地武士对议长的所作所为日益警惕，时刻留意着任何背叛的蛛丝马迹。不过和其余绝地一样，等他察觉到真正发生了什么，一切早已为时太晚。

en: The success of the mission on Mygeeto was something of a revelation for the men of the 501st.  Suddenly, we realized that the Jedi could be fooled.  And if they could be fooled, they could be killed.
zh: 麦基托任务的成功对第501军团的弟兄们来说不啻一场顿悟。突然间我们意识到，绝地武士是可以被欺骗的。既然能被欺骗，那就能被杀死。

en: During the Rise of the Empire, the Emperor's home planet of Naboo rapidly established itself as a major irritant.  After a number of Naboo's ambassadors were sent home in various states of dismemberment, her newly-elected Queen broke off diplomatic ties and began exploring military options.  Clearly, it was time for a regime change; a change that would be affected by the 501st, now under the direct command of Darth Vader.  Our orders were to infiltrate the city and take out their leader, sending a clear signal to other potential troublemakers in the Empire..
zh: 在帝国崛起时期，皇帝的母星纳布迅速成为了一个眼中钉。在数名纳布大使以各种残缺不全的状态被送回国后，新当选的女王断绝了外交关系，并开始考虑军事选项。显然，是时候改朝换代了；而这场变革将由现在直接听命于达斯·维达的第501军团来实施。我们的命令是潜入城市，干掉他们的领袖，向帝国其他潜在的麻烦制造者发出明确的信号。

en: With the Queen eliminated, Naboo quickly fell in line.  It was the first time the 501st was called upon to 'adjust' a planet's government, but it wouldn't be the last.  Within months the 501st gained a well-deserved reputation as 'Vader's Fist.'
zh: 女王被除掉后，纳布迅速安分下来。这是第501军团头一次被召去“调整”一颗星球的政治格局，但绝不会是最后一次。短短几个月内，第501军团就赢得了“维达之拳”这一当之无愧的名声。

en: By the time of the raid on Polis Massa, the men of the 501st were starting to get a little sick of this so-called 'Rebellion.'  In the past, we'd secretly enjoyed putting down a local insurrection or two; they kept the troops sharp and the Empire feared.  But these rebels were different.  They were organized, they were growing, and they were everywhere.  The raid on Polis Massa was a perfect example of how things were starting to fall apart.  We were supposed to go in, wipe out a small band of Rebels, and recover some stolen Imperial plans on an encrypted holodisk.  Before we knew it, we were nearly overrun by Rebel forces, with the holodisk nowhere to be found.
zh: 到突袭波利斯·马萨的时候，第501军团的弟兄们已经开始有点厌烦这个所谓的“义军”了。过去，我们私下里还挺享受镇压一两次地方叛乱——那能让部队保持锋利，让帝国保持威慑。但这次的反抗军不一样。他们组织严密，不断壮大，无处不在。突袭波利斯·马萨就是局面开始失控的绝佳例证。我们本该潜入进去，消灭一小股反抗军，夺回一份刻在加密全息碟上的被盗帝国计划。可转眼之间，我们就被反抗军主力打得几乎溃不成军，全息碟更是踪影全无。

en: Even though the Polis Massa raid was only a partial success, we finally had a lead on the whereabouts of the Death Star plans, which suited the 501st just fine.
zh: 尽管突袭波利斯·马萨只算部分成功，我们总算掌握了死星设计图下落的一条线索，这对第501军团来说正合适。

en: As the Clone Wars progressed, more and more ground-based legions found themselves pressed into space combat, including the fighting forces of the 501st.  For months, every hour of our downtime was spent in the simulator, preparing for the time we would face our enemies from the cockpit of a 170.  Finally the day came to earn our wings.  The CIS had staged a daring kidnapping of Chancellor Palpatine, and was being escorted from Coruscant by a fleet of Separatist ships.  With only a few veteran pilots on-planet, many of the 501st were pressed into service to drive off the Seps, and buy time for a pair of Jedi Knights to rescue the Chancellor.
zh: 随着克隆人战争不断推进，越来越多的地面军团被迫投入太空作战，第501军团的战斗力量也不例外。几个月来，我们的每一点闲暇时间都花在了模拟器上，为有朝一日坐在ARC-170的座舱里与敌人交手做准备。终于，赢得飞行资格的那一天来临了。分离势力胆大包天地绑架了帕尔帕廷议长，一支分离势力舰队正护送他离开科洛桑。由于星球上经验丰富的飞行员寥寥无几，第501军团的许多战士被迫临阵上机，驱赶分离势力，为两名绝地武士营救议长争取时间。

en: And so the battle over Yavin came to an end.  I'm told we destroyed hundreds of Rebel ships that day.  Even if it had been thousands, it wouldn't have made up for the Death Star.
zh: 雅文上空的战役就这样结束了。据说那天我们摧毁了数百艘义军飞船。就算有数千艘，也弥补不了死星的损失。

en: When the Separatist invasion of Kashyyyk caught the Republic flatfooted, a detachment of the 501st was sent in to stop the bleeding until reinforcements could arrive.  It was a textbook suicide mission, and we knew it.  As we fought our way into the Kashyyyk's atmosphere, most of us believed that the only way we'd be getting off this planet was in a body bag.
zh: 当分离势力对卡希克的入侵打得共和国措手不及时，一支第501军团特遣队被派去止血，一直撑到增援抵达。这是一场教科书式的自杀任务，我们心知肚明。当我们一路厮杀进入卡希克的大气层时，我们大多数人相信，离开这颗星球的唯一方式就是被装进尸袋。

en: Although the Clone Wars were over, some people never seemed to get the message.  The worst case of denial was Gizor Dellso, a Geonosian Separatist who'd somehow escaped Lord Vader's efforts to wipe out the remnants of the CIS.  When he popped his head up long enough to steal the plans to a new Imperial fighter, Lord Vader tracked him to Mustafar, and brought us in to finish the job.  It seemed like a simple enough mission, but we saw the fleet of droid ships hovering over the planet, we suddenly realized that Dellso's denial mechanisms were a little more dangerous than we'd imagined.
zh: 尽管克隆人战争已经结束，有些人似乎始终没明白这个道理。最执迷不悟的例子就是吉佐·德尔索——一个吉奥诺西斯分离主义者，不知怎么从维达大人清剿独立星系邦联残部的行动中溜掉了。当他终于冒出头来偷走一款新型帝国战斗机的设计图时，维达大人一路追踪他到穆斯塔法，并调我们来收尾。这任务看起来很简单，但看到悬浮在星球上空的那支机器人舰队时，我们才猛然意识到，德尔索的“拒不认输”比我们想象的危险得多。

en: Officially, there never was a 'Clone Rebellion' on Kamino.  Unofficially, approximately twenty years after we were created, a special detachment of the Imperial 501st Legion was dispatched to Kamino, with orders to eradicate an army of clones that had been bred to take arms against the Empire.  For many of us, it was the first time we'd seen the planet of our 'birth' in nearly a decade.
zh: 官方说法是，卡米诺上从未发生过“克隆人叛乱”。而实际上，在我们被创造出来大约二十年后，一支帝国第501军团的特遣队被派往卡米诺，奉命剿灭一支被培育出来武装反抗帝国的克隆人军队。对我们许多人来说，这是近十年来第一次回到我们“出生”的星球。

en: The slight whiff of nostalgia the 501st had enjoyed fighting the droid fleet over Mustafar had already grown sour by the time we'd established orbital positions.  Now it was time to find out what this was all about.
zh: 第501军团在穆斯塔法上空与机器人舰队作战时的那一丝怀旧之情，到我们占据轨道阵位时早已变了味。现在是时候弄清楚这一切究竟是怎么回事了。

en: When the Death Star was destroyed, about half of 501st Legion was still in the hangar, getting into their ships.  Of those who made it out, another third were caught in the explosion.I'd fought with some of those men for over twenty years.  Afterwards, those of us that survived hooked up with a nearby Imperial fleet making a retaliatory strike on the Rebel's base on Yavin 4.  It wasn't the best thought-out plan, but we were cut-off from our leaders, tired, and operating on instinct.  If not for our training, we probably would never gotten past their orbital defenses.
zh: 死星被摧毁时，第501军团大约一半人还在机库里登机。侥幸逃出来的人中，又有三分之一被卷入爆炸。我与其中一些弟兄并肩作战超过二十年。事后，我们这些幸存者与附近一支帝国舰队会合，对义军在雅文4号的基地发起报复性打击。这算不上什么深思熟虑的计划，但我们与指挥官失去了联系，疲惫不堪，全凭本能作战。若非我们受过训练，恐怕连他们的轨道防御都突破不了。

en: Our new TIE fighters quickly outmatched the old ARC170s of our rebellious cousins.  As we zoomed to the planet's surface, we braced ourselves for what would surely be the strangest battle of our lives.
zh: 我们全新的TIE战斗机迅速压过了我们那些叛逆“表亲”驾驶的老式ARC-170。当我们高速冲向星球表面时，已经做好了迎接一生中最离奇战斗的准备。

en: After disabling the final capital ship, General Kenobi and Skywalker took advantage of the opportunity we'd created, and rescued the Chancellor.  Took all the credit, too.
zh: 瘫痪最后一艘主力舰后，欧比旺将军和天行者利用我们创造的机会，救出了议长。功劳也被他们全占去了。

en: As the 501st finally broke through the Sep blockade over Kashyyyk, I took a long look back at the battle that continued to rage over the planet, and wondered why so many had to die for a bunch of walking carpets.  Then I followed my orders, and turned planetward.
zh: 当第501军团终于突破卡希克上空的分离势力封锁时，我久久回望身后仍在星球上空激战的战场，不禁纳闷，为什么要有这么多人为了一群会走路的毛毯去死。随后我服从命令，转向星球方向。

en: With the information gathered on Polis Massa, Vader concluded that the stolen plans had been given to Princess Leia Organa of Alderaan.  We weren't surprised; for all their talk of being a 'peaceful planet,' Alderaan had been thumbing its nose at the Empire for years.  Our Destroyer intercepted the Princess's ship, the Tantive IV, over Tatooine.  After a brief and pointless battle, we boarded the ship, began looking for the plans, and waited for Lord Vader's arrival.
zh: 凭借在波利斯·马萨搜集到的情报，维达断定被盗的设计图已经交给了奥德朗的莱娅·奥加纳公主。我们并不意外；尽管奥德朗整天标榜自己是“和平星球”，多年来却一直在跟帝国对着干。我们的歼星舰在塔图因上空截获了公主的飞船——坦蒂夫四号。经过一场短暂而无谓的战斗后，我们登上了飞船，开始搜寻设计图，等待维达大人驾临。

en: After Lord Vader took custody of Princess Leia, we all figured it was just a matter of time before she coughed up the plans.  Many of us had been unwilling witnesses to Vader's powers of persuasion in the past.the thought of a pampered little princess resisting his terrible will was inconceivable.
zh: 维达大人接管莱娅公主后，我们都以为她招供设计图只是时间问题。我们中许多人曾不情愿地见识过维达的“说服”手段。一个娇生惯养的小公主竟能抵挡他那可怕意志——这简直难以想象。

en: In our bones, we knew the war was almost over.  The galaxy held its breath, waiting to see which side would make the final, daring move.  As fortune would have it, the Republic moved first.  After the Chancellor informed the Jedi Council that General Grievous and the Sep leaders were hiding on Utapau, General Kenobi gathered an army 'large enough to capture three star systems,' and prepared to ambush the Separatists before they could escape.   When the orders reached the 501st, our morale soared; for better or worse, this would be the beginning of the end.
zh: 我们骨子里都清楚，战争快要结束了。银河系屏息凝神，等着看哪一方会走出最后那步险棋。天意如此，共和国先动了手。议长告知绝地委员会，格里弗斯将军和分离势力头目正躲藏在尤塔帕，欧比旺将军随即集结了一支“足以攻占三个星系”的军队，准备在分离势力逃走之前伏击他们。命令传到第501军团时，全军士气高涨；无论如何，这都将是终结的开始。

en: With the death of General Grievous at the hands of General Kenobi, the Utapau raid had broken the back of the Separatists.  Under normal circumstances, it would have been a time for celebration.  But our next orders put paid to those thoughts.
zh: 格里弗斯将军死于欧比旺将军之手，尤塔帕突袭彻底打断了分离势力的脊梁。正常情况下，这该是欢庆的时刻。但我们接下来的命令让这些念头烟消云散。

en: By the time we'd landed on Yavin, whatever shock we'd felt at the destruction of the Death Star had been replaced by anger.  For months we'd treated the Rebellion like a disobedient child, only to be repaid for our tolerance with treachery on an unimaginable scale.  Frankly, I don't remember much of the fighting.  A couple days later, an Imperial transport picked us up, in the middle of Yavin's jungles, our armor coated with all sorts of blood.  I guess we won.
zh: 等我们在雅文登陆时，死星被毁带来的震惊早已被怒火取代。几个月来，我们一直把义军当作不听话的孩子对待，换来的却是这种难以想象的背叛。说实话，战斗的大部分细节我已经记不清了。几天后，一艘帝国运输船在雅文丛林的深处接走了我们，我们的盔甲上沾满了各式各样的血迹。我想，我们赢了。

en: After the battle, the surviving members of the 501st finally caught their breath.  The Empire had taken the Rebels' best shot, and come up standing.  Now it was our turn to strike.
zh: 战斗结束后，第501军团的幸存者们终于喘了口气。帝国挨了义军最重的一击，依然屹立不倒。现在轮到我们出手了。

en: Please enter at least one character

Tips and Tricks:

Multipurpose fighters, such as X-wings, are versatile craft that can engage both enemy fighters and capital ships. However, they are less effective at either task in comparison to the specialized classes.
zh:
小贴士：

多功能战斗机，如 X 翼战机，既能对抗敌方战斗机，也能攻击主力舰。但与专用机型相比，它们在两项任务上的表现都略逊一筹。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

The glowing portion of the lightsaber shows how much time the player has left to use the hero. Each time the hero gets hit, additional time will be lost from the hero bar. Time is gained by defeating enemies.
zh:
小贴士：

光剑发光的部位显示了玩家剩余的英雄使用时间。英雄每次受到攻击，英雄槽都会额外减少时间。击败敌人则可获得时间。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

Lock-on allows you to track your targets by keeping your enemy on screen. Press the lock-on button to track a particular enemy; hold down the lock-on button to clear the lock. You can also use the lock-on button to make rocket launchers home in on vehicles.
zh:
小贴士：

锁定功能可让你通过将敌人保持在屏幕上来追踪目标。按下锁定键锁定特定敌人；按住锁定键解除锁定。你也可以用锁定键让火箭筒制导追踪载具。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

Players must exit vehicles to pick up flags, with the exception of starfighters in Space.
zh:
小贴士：

玩家必须离开载具才能拾取旗帜，太空战中的星际战斗机除外。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

Droidekas need to deploy from ball mode to pick up flags.
zh:
小贴士：

毁灭者机器人必须从球形态展开后才能拾取旗帜。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

Jet Troopers, Dark Troopers and Jedi can't use their flight abilities while they have the flag.
zh:
小贴士：

喷气突击兵、黑暗突击兵和绝地武士在携带旗帜时无法使用飞行能力。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

Rockets and bombs need time in the air to build to their maximum speed and damage. Fire from long range for maximum impact.
zh:
小贴士：

火箭和炸弹需要飞行时间才能达到最大速度和伤害。远距离发射以获得最大效果。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

Engineers can slice into enemy occupied vehicles by using their fusion cutters. However, command vehicles such as the AT-TE are immune to slicing.
zh:
小贴士：

工程兵可以使用聚变切割器切入敌方占领的载具。但 AT-TE 等指挥载具免疫切入。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

The detpack is a powerful remote explosive, ideally suited to destroy tough enemy installations. It's also an excellent ambush tool when planted where the enemy least expects it. Once one is placed, use your secondary fire button again to detonate it.
zh:
小贴士：

炸药包是一种威力强大的遥控炸药，非常适合摧毁坚固的敌方设施。埋在敌人最意想不到的地方，也是绝佳的伏击工具。放置后，再次使用副武器键即可引爆。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

Mines can be deployed to cut off narrow choke points. If you see an enemy mine, use a rocket or a detonator to destroy it from a safe distance. Keep in mind that engineer units can safely bypass enemy mines.
zh:
小贴士：

地雷可用来封锁狭窄的咽喉要道。如果发现敌方地雷，请在安全距离用火箭或引爆装置将其摧毁。请注意，工程兵可以安全绕过敌方地雷。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

Each faction has one class, such as the Clone Commander, that offers significant bonuses to nearby teammates. Stick together and work as a team to take full advantage of these abilities.
zh:
小贴士：

每个阵营都有一个兵种（如克隆指挥官）能为附近的队友提供显著增益。团结协作，充分利用这些能力。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

Bombers and their powerful ordnance are quite effective for attacking capital ships, but their heavy armor makes them slow and less maneuverable.
zh:
小贴士：

轰炸机及其强大的弹药对攻击主力舰非常有效，但厚重的装甲使它们行动缓慢、机动性差。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

Several weapons, such as the Wookiee bowcaster, can be charged up to greatly increase their range, power, or targeting area. Hold down the primary fire button for a few seconds to charge your weapon.
zh:
小贴士：

某些武器（如伍基弩枪）可以蓄力，大幅提升射程、威力或打击范围。按住主武器键数秒即可为武器蓄力。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

Snipers are most effective at higher elevations far from major combat. When you find a secluded spot, take your shot and then move on. Don't give your location away.
zh:
小贴士：

狙击手在远离主战场的制高点最为有效。找到隐蔽处后，开一枪就转移阵地，不要暴露自己的位置。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

The recon droid can be deployed to survey the battlefield remotely while the officer remains hidden. Use the droid's blaster and self-destruct feature to take enemies by surprise and clear the way for your teammates.
zh:
小贴士：

侦察机器人可被部署以远程侦察战场，而军官则保持隐蔽。利用机器人的爆能枪和自毁功能出其不意地打击敌人，为队友扫清道路。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

The stamina bar appears below your health bar. Sprinting, rolling, and other strenuous actions use stamina. Stamina recovers over time.
zh:
小贴士：

耐力条显示在生命值条下方。冲刺、翻滚和其他剧烈动作会消耗耐力。耐力会随时间恢复。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

The lightsaber can be used to automatically block incoming fire by pressing the Lightsaber Block button. Your Jedi will block all enemy fire in front of him until his stamina runs out.
zh:
小贴士：

按光剑格挡键可自动格挡来袭火力。在耐力耗尽前，你的绝地武士将格挡面前的所有敌方火力。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

Force powers such as push, pull, choke, lightning, jump, and speed give the Jedi a huge advantage over typical infantry. Use their unique and powerful abilities to dominate the battlefront.
zh:
小贴士：

原力推、原力拉、原力锁喉、原力闪电、原力跳跃和原力加速等原力技能让绝地武士相对于普通步兵拥有巨大优势。用这些独特而强大的能力主宰战场。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

Wookiee warriors are extremely tough and can take more punishment than the typical soldier. Though slow moving, they are heavily armed and can survey the area through the use of a recon droid.
zh:
小贴士：

伍基战士极其坚韧，能承受比普通士兵更多的伤害。虽然行动缓慢，但他们火力强大，还可以使用侦察机器人侦察周围区域。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

Bothan Spies are masters of stealth and sabotage. Use their stealth ability to sneak behind enemy lines, and then wreak havoc with a time bomb.
zh:
小贴士：

博萨间谍是潜行与破坏的大师。利用潜行能力潜入敌后，再用定时炸弹制造混乱。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

Infantry can sprint to evade attack or cover a large area quickly. Many vehicles can also boost for a quick burst of speed. Vary your speed to switch up your tactics.
zh:
小贴士：

步兵可以冲刺躲避攻击或快速穿越大片区域。许多载具也能加速冲刺。灵活变换速度，调整你的战术。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

Some turrets are more effective against vehicles; others are more effective against infantry. All are powerful; use the right turret for the job to defeat your enemies quickly.
zh:
小贴士：

有些炮塔对载具更有效，有些则对步兵更有效。所有炮塔都很强大；针对任务选择正确的炮塔，快速消灭敌人。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

Scout class fighters, such as the TIE Interceptor, are nimble and lightning fast. They are devastating in dogfights but don't have the armor or firepower to attack capital ships.
zh:
小贴士：

侦察型战斗机（如 TIE 截击机）灵活敏捷、快如闪电。它们在缠斗中威力惊人，但没有装甲和火力来攻击主力舰。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

For each medal earned the player will be rewarded with one point. After four points are earned a special bonus will be awarded in that category. Players that reach Legendary status will be able to permanently keep their bonuses during singleplayer gameplay modes.
zh:
小贴士：

玩家每获得一枚勋章即可获得一分。积满四分后，该类别将获得特别奖励。达到传奇军衔的玩家可以在单人游戏模式中永久保留奖励。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

Jet Troopers and Dark Troopers can get around the battlefield faster than any other infantry but have less armor. When surrounded by enemies, they can easily fly to safety.
zh:
小贴士：

喷气突击兵和黑暗突击兵在战场上的机动速度比任何其他步兵都快，但护甲较弱。被敌人包围时，他们可以轻松飞离险境。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

Clone Commanders carry extremely powerful rapid-fire chainguns. The weapon is slow to warm up, but once it begins firing it will unleash a punishing volley of blaster shots that few enemies can withstand.
zh:
小贴士：

克隆指挥官携带威力极强的速射机枪。该武器预热缓慢，但一旦开始射击，就会倾泻出令敌人难以抵挡的爆能弹幕。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

If you're trying to capture a Command Post and the capture icon is flashing, it means there are still enemies nearby. Wipe them out to capture the Command Post for your side.
zh:
小贴士：

如果你试图占领指挥点而占领图标在闪烁，说明附近仍有敌人。消灭他们，就能为己方占领指挥点。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

Many vehicles, such as the AT-TE, have more than one position that can be manned. Press the Next Position button when you're in a vehicle to take advantage of different weapons and viewpoints.
zh:
小贴士：

许多载具（如 AT-TE）有多个可搭乘的位置。在载具内按「切换位置」键，可使用不同的武器和视角。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

If the auto-target game option is turned on, you will automatically lock-on to the first enemy you hit. You can turn off the lock-on by holding down the lock-on button.
zh:
小贴士：

如果开启了自动瞄准游戏选项，你将自动锁定第一个命中的敌人。按住锁定键可解除锁定。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

Snipers can deploy auto-turrets to defend key areas. The auto-turrets will hover in mid-air and shoot at all enemies until it is destroyed or its energy runs out.
zh:
小贴士：

狙击手可以部署自动炮塔防守关键区域。自动炮塔会在空中悬浮，向所有敌人射击，直到被摧毁或能量耗尽。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

Speederbikes have a limited jump ability while moving; try pressing the jump button the next time you're driving a speederbike.
zh:
小贴士：

飞车在行进中拥有有限的跳跃能力；下次驾驶飞车时试试按下跳跃键。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

Many ground vehicles have a critical hit location. If a rocket hits this location on the vehicle, it will do far more damage than it normally would.
zh:
小贴士：

许多地面载具有弱点位置。如果火箭击中该位置，造成的伤害将远超平常。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

You earn points on the battlefield for performing different actions. For example, points are earned for capturing CPs, returning enemy flags, and eliminating enemy units. Special classes such as the Bothan Spy and Clone Commander become available when enough points are earned.
zh:
小贴士：

在战场上执行不同行动可获得积分。例如，占领指挥点、送回敌方旗帜和消灭敌方单位都能获得积分。当积分足够时，博萨间谍和克隆指挥官等特殊兵种将解锁。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

Transports are slow moving craft that carry more than one trooper for boarding parties. If you manage to land a transport inside an enemy hangar, you can also spawn infantry from it.
zh:
小贴士：

运输船是缓慢的飞行器，可搭载多名士兵执行登陆任务。如果你设法将运输船降落在敌方机库内，还可以从中出动步兵。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

All Jedi are capable of unleashing a powerful sprint attack. Sprint towards your enemy and follow through with your lightsaber. A well-timed attack can make quick work of most enemy units.
zh:
小贴士：

所有绝地武士都能发动强力的冲刺攻击。冲向敌人并用光剑顺势挥击。时机得当的攻击可以迅速解决大多数敌方单位。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

A moving Droideka is a vulnerable Droideka. Deploy from ball mode and press your secondary attack button to activate your shield. The shield will dissipate after it runs out of energy or if you re-enter ball mode.
zh:
小贴士：

移动中的毁灭者机器人是脆弱的。从球形态展开后，按下副攻击键激活护盾。护盾在能量耗尽或重新变回球形态后消失。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

Fusion cutters are capable of much more than just slicing into vehicles. They can repair vehicles, ammo and health droids, and are even capable of constructing turrets. Anyone who masters the fusion cutter will be a valuable asset to any team.
zh:
小贴士：

聚变切割器的作用远不止切入载具。它们可以修理载具、弹药机器人和医疗机器人，甚至还能建造炮塔。掌握聚变切割器的任何人都将成为队伍的重要资产。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

Jedi Force Jump is available to all Jedi. Hit the jump button once to jump, and again to activate the Force Jump. A skilled Jedi will use this ability to move quickly throughout the battlefront.
zh:
小贴士：

所有绝地武士都能使用原力跳跃。按一下跳跃键跳跃，再按一下激活原力跳跃。熟练的绝地武士会利用这一能力在战场上快速移动。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

Special classes, such as the MagnaGuard, are capable of initiating area effect buffs. Some are beneficial to the team while others can be detrimental to the enemy. Learning when to use these buffs can sway the outcome of the battle in your favor.
zh:
小贴士：

像警卫机器人这样的特殊兵种能够发动范围增益效果。有些增益对己方有利，有些则能削弱敌人。学会把握使用这些增益的时机，可以左右战局。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

The Dark Trooper's arc caster is capable of attacking several foes. Charge up your attack and unload towards a group of enemies. If it makes contact with one of them, it can chain up to four additional nearby units.
zh:
小贴士：

黑暗突击兵的弧形电枪可以攻击多个敌人。蓄力后向一群敌人倾泻。只要击中其中一个，就能连锁攻击附近最多四个额外目标。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

Several vehicles, such as the AT-ST and Space Transports, have positions which offer remote rockets. Control these rockets just as you would a starfighter. For maximum damage, accelerate to full boost speed before making contact with your target.
zh:
小贴士：

AT-ST 和太空运输船等载具拥有可发射遥控火箭的位置。像驾驶星际战斗机一样操控这些火箭。为造成最大伤害，请在命中目标前加速到全速。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

Score a critical hit on enemy units by aiming for their heads. A skilled sniper will be able to eliminate most enemy infantry within a single, well-aimed head shot. Only Droidekas are immune to head shots.
zh:
小贴士：

瞄准头部可对敌方单位造成暴击。熟练的狙击手只需一发精准的爆头就能消灭大多数敌方步兵。只有毁灭者机器人免疫爆头。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

The Bothan Spy's incinerator weapon is capable of disintegrating enemies. Sneak in close while under the stealth effect and unleash a deadly wave of incinerating blasts to eliminate small groups of enemies.
zh:
小贴士：

博萨间谍的焚化武器能够瓦解敌人。在潜行效果下悄悄靠近，释放致命的焚化冲击波，消灭小股敌人。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

The Pilot class is best suited for space combat. Their ability to automatically repair their own starfighter during flight is an invaluable skill while dogfighting.
zh:
小贴士：

飞行员兵种最适合太空作战。飞行中自动修复自身星际战斗机的能力在缠斗中极为宝贵。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

The color of the outer bar indicates whether your target is friend or foe. Blue is for allies and Red is for enemies.
zh:
小贴士：

外圈血条的颜色表示目标敌友。蓝色代表盟友，红色代表敌人。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

Command Posts cannot be captured in CTF, but you'll still be able to swap out for another infantry class through the CPs you control.
zh:
小贴士：

在夺旗模式中无法占领指挥点，但你仍可通过己方控制的指挥点更换其他步兵兵种。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

Special awards are given to players that accomplish amazing feats within one life. For instance, a sniper that lands six head shots in one sitting will be awarded with a Marksman medal. This medal offers the sniper an upgraded sniper rifle. See if you can unlock other medals throughout the game.
zh:
小贴士：

在一命之内完成惊人壮举的玩家将获得特殊奖励。例如，一名狙击手在一场战斗中打出六次爆头，将获得「神射手」勋章。这枚勋章为狙击手提供升级版狙击枪。看看你能否在游戏中解锁更多勋章。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

The awards given to you through medals won't last forever. A 30 second grace period is given to any player that earns a medal after Veteran status has been achieved. After those 30 seconds are up, you'll lose your bonus the next time you're killed.
zh:
小贴士：

通过勋章获得的奖励不会永久持续。在达到老兵军衔后，获得勋章的玩家将享有 30 秒的宽限期。30 秒结束后，你下次阵亡时将失去奖励。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

The Game Options menu offers you many customizable features. For instance, toggling Display Enemy Icons 'On' will display a red icon above every enemy unit, vehicle or turret found on the battlefront.
zh:
小贴士：

游戏选项菜单提供许多自定义功能。例如，将「显示敌人图标」切换为「开」，战场上的每个敌方单位、载具或炮塔上方都会显示红色图标。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

Locking onto an enemy starfighter provides detailed information about your target. The bottom-right portion of your screen displays their starfighter type, health, pilot name, and distance from you. Use this information to plan your attack accordingly.
zh:
小贴士：

锁定敌方星际战斗机会提供目标的详细信息。屏幕右下角显示其星际战斗机类型、生命值、飞行员姓名和与你之间的距离。据此规划你的进攻。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

The tick marks inside the reticule indicate how much ammo is left in your current clip.
zh:
小贴士：

准星内的刻度线表示当前弹匣剩余的弹药量。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

Some weapons don't have ammo limits but do overheat instead. A circular bar inside the reticule indicates the heat is building up. If the bar turns completely red, you must wait for the weapon to cool down before you can fire again.
zh:
小贴士：

某些武器没有弹药限制，但会过热。准星内的圆形指示条会显示热量积聚情况。如果指示条完全变红，你必须等待武器冷却后才能再次开火。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

The center of the reticule will flash if your shot hits a target. A forked symbol in the center indicates that you've scored a critical hit.
zh:
小贴士：

如果射击命中目标，准星中心会闪烁。中心的叉形符号表示你命中了暴击。

en:
Tips and Tricks:

When your primary weapon reloads or recharges, you'll see five dots in the bottom of the reticule. Secondary weapon reload/recharge delays appear as three dots around the edge of the reticule.
zh:
小贴士：

主武器装填或充能时，准星底部会出现五个点。副武器装填/充能的延迟则显示为准星边缘的三个点。
